tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a new document from markdown or HTML content. Requires a collectionId to place the document in a collection, or parentDocumentId to nest it under an existing document.

collectionId.description: The collection to place the document in.

format.description: The format of the text content. Defaults to "markdown".

parentDocumentId.description: The parent document ID to nest this document under.

publish.description: Whether to publish the document. Defaults to true.

text.description: The content of the document. Interpreted as markdown unless format is set to "html".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches a document, collection, user, attachment, or template by type and ID.
